svg.title: Side-by-Side Comparison of the Triangle of Lifts and Two-Grid Turns Built on OneSquare.lean in Stage 05
svg.desc: Publication-grade side-by-side mathematical diagram contrasting the two combinatorial engines built on OneSquare.lean (SquareLaw) in Stage 05 of the Riemann Hypothesis proof. At the top, a shared foundation strip presents OneSquare.lean (SquareLaw), which commutes lifts past descents up to local L-value ratios and feeds both panels. The Left Panel (cobalt, diamond badges) depicts the Triangle of Lifts in NormOfChain.lean and ChainNorms.lean via a schematic m = 3 triangular lattice of nodes (i, n) with i + n <= 3: top chain (0,0) to (0,1) to (0,2) to (0,3) representing Y_0 to Y_3, and internal nodes (1,0), (1,1), (1,2), (2,0), (2,1), (3,0). Three shaded OneSquare cells slide lifts past descents down to the m = 3 convergent first-step Rallis operators R_1, R_2, R_3 along the hypotenuse base, yielding Theta_vartheta* Theta_vartheta = c(vartheta) c_Q^m rallisProduct (where rallisProduct = prod_{j=1}^m R_j) and picking up prod_{1 <= i < j <= m} quotientRatio_{i,j} with inverse height at most m^2 t x_1. Stage 04 trace comparison (det_rallisOnGood_eq) transfers determinants between indefinite Y_0 and definite W_j, yielding exists_chainDeterminant_pos_and_div_chainDeterminant_one_eq: Z(vartheta)/Z(1) = (Nm(Q)^(e/2) prod quotientRatio)^d prod_{j=1}^m Z_j(vartheta^j)/Z_j(1), with positivity C > 0 proved separately from Rallis injectivity. The Right Panel (emerald and amber/rust, circle, square, and diamond markers) depicts the Two Square Grids and m^2 Turns in SpanningForms.lean and DiagonalTurns.lean via a schematic m = 3 two-grid lattice: lower-left half Y^a_b (cobalt circles) and upper-right half Y_tilde^b_a (emerald squares) meeting along the shared diagonal (l, l) (amber diamonds) with S = Y^{j+1}_j = Y_tilde^{j+1}_j. It contrasts the dashed rust First Path (lowerChain Y_m <- ... <- Y_0 paired with restriction r from Y_tilde^m_0) against the solid emerald Last Path (Y_m -> ... -> Y^m_m <- ... <- Y_tilde^m_0, all definite spaces), connected by m^2 = 9 turns: 6 off-diagonal OneSquare turns plus 3 diagonal seesaw turns (DiagonalTurns.lean), picking up prod_{i,j < m} turnRatio_{i,j}. Pairing against dual-weight delta forms delta_x(v) (exists_dualPairing_eq_mul_lastPathPeriod) and pushing short deep-level forms on Y_tilde^m_0 (span_isShort_eq_top_gridLevelForms) through r establishes exists_span_short_lifts_eq_top: weylNormSq <= exp(x^202 b^2) and p-integrality for p not dividing Nm(Q). A bottom contrast strip summarizes the structural difference: the triangle stops at the convergent base of first-step Rallis operators, whereas the two-grid crosses the shared diagonal via extra seesaws on S = Y^{j+1}_j = Y_tilde^{j+1}_j to reach definite deep-level forms.

g.text: Two Combinatorial Engines Built on OneSquare.lean
Commutes one lift past one descent up to a local L-value ratio
Feeds two distinct geometric layouts on the indefinite target space Y0:
◆ Left Panel: Triangle of lifts → Gram determinant Z(ϑ)/Z(1) │ ● Right Panel: Two square grids → short p-integral spanning lifts
SCHEMATIC m = 3 TRIANGLE · nodes (i, n) with i + n ≤ 3
Slides lifts past descents to m convergent first-step Rallis base lifts
Slide Lifts Past Descents → Rallis Product
Picks up ∏1≤i<j≤m quotientRatioi,j (inv. scalar height ≤ m2 t x1)
▲ Honesty: positivity C > 0 proved separately from Rallis injectivity
det_rallisOnGood_eq: det(Rj) transfers indefinite Y0 ↔ definite Wj
Dividing by ϑ = 1 cancels base constants C, cQ across all m factors
Strict positivity Z(ϑ) > 0, Zj(ϑj) > 0 (C > 0 via injectivity)
● RIGHT PANEL · TWO SQUARE GRIDS & m² TURNS
SCHEMATIC m = 3 TWO-GRID · Yab & Ỹba meeting at (l, l)
Shared diagonal S = Yj+1j = Ỹj+1j · 6 OneSquare + 3 seesaw turns
Sweep First Path → Definite Last Path
Last-path period (all definite) picks up ∏i,j<m turnRatioi,j
Clears edge kernels/flip scalar: p-int ≤ exp(x99b2), arch. ≤ exp(x200b2)
Short Ỹm0 forms (span_isShort_eq_top_gridLevelForms) pushed via r
● RIGHT OUTPUT · SHORT INTEGRAL SPANNING FAMILY
weylNormSq ≤ exp(x202 b2) · p-integral for p ∤ Nm(Q)
Spans principal forms on Y0 via (c(ϑ)/c(1)) · lowerChainAtLevel
▲ STRUCTURAL CONTRAST · WHY THESE ARE NOT JUST "TWO COPIES OF OneSquare"
Different boundary geometry at the diagonal
◆ Triangle (NormOfChain) stops at the convergent base
The diagonal is the base where first-step Rallis operators Rj already
converge: pure OneSquare sliding + Stage 04 trace comparison
transfers determinants directly from indefinite Y0 to definite Wj.
● Two-Grid (SpanningForms) crosses the diagonal via seesaws
Crossing (l, l) between Yab and Ỹba is NOT an OneSquare move:
it requires extra seesaws on S = Yj+1j = Ỹj+1j (DiagonalTurns.lean)
to swap grids and reach definite deep-level forms on Ỹm0.
